name: tabby-highlight-pane
description: Tabby plugin that highlights the active split pane

scripts.deploy:
node node_modules/webpack-cli/bin/cli.js --progress && powershell -Command "Copy-Item dist\index.js '%APPDATA%	abby\plugins
ode_modules	abby-highlight-pane\dist\index.js' -Force; Copy-Item dist\index.js.map '%APPDATA%	abby\plugins
ode_modules	abby-highlight-pane\dist\index.js.map' -Force; Copy-Item package.json '%APPDATA%	abby\plugins
ode_modules	abby-highlight-pane\package.json' -Force; Write-Host 'Deploy complete'"
